title: Normalized image asset definition (legacy images domain)
description: Contract for one normalized image asset: one stored legacy images object entry. The asset path is the stable identity, so legacy_id is the path verbatim (rule M2); the locale must be exactly en (rule M1). Paths are recorded references only, never checked against disk or executed (M4 owns asset truth). See packages/game-content/README.md for the rule set and survey citations.

legacy_id.description: Stored images object key (asset path) preserved verbatim: slashes, case, and extension untouched (rule M2).

kind.description: Classification of the stored images domain: every entry maps to image_asset.

source_file.description: Origin file of the stored entry: config/main.json (no patch targets images).

source_layer.description: Layering origin: stored (no patch targets images).

content_version.description: Content fingerprint (sha256 over the stored source bytes plus the mods list); sources carry no version stamp.

path.description: Asset path preserved verbatim; recorded reference only, never checked against disk or executed (rule M2).

locale.description: Locale tag, exactly en; anything else fails as drift (rule M1).
